## EDA in R (Full Script)

```{r}
# EDA in R (full script)
project_csv <-read.csv("C:/Users/tyler/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/work_to_show/Classes Spring 2026/BDA Spring 26/project.csv",header=TRUE) # FORWARD SLASH AND HEADER TRUE IF HAVE COLUMN NAMES
# column names
colnames(project_csv) # "days_duration" "project_cost" 
#head of the data
head(project_csv)
#summary of the days_duration column
summary(project_csv$days_duration)
#summary of the project_cost column
summary(project_csv$project_cost)
# mean of columns
mean(project_csv$days_duration)
mean(project_csv$project_cost)
# stand dev of columns
sd(project_csv$days_duration)
sd(project_csv$project_cost)
# finding the regression line 
mean(project_csv$days_duration)+3*sd(project_csv$days_duration)
mean(project_csv$days_duration)-3*sd(project_csv$days_duration)
mean(project_csv$project_cost)+3*sd(project_csv$project_cost)
mean(project_csv$project_cost)-3*sd(project_csv$project_cost)
#histogram
hist(project_csv$days_duration)
hist(project_csv$project_cost)
#plot with ab line
plot(project_csv$days_duration,type="b")
abline(h=mean(project_csv$days_duration))
plot(project_csv$project_cost,type="b")
abline(h=mean(project_csv$project_cost))
#correlation
cor(project_csv$days_duration,project_csv$project_cost)
plot(project_csv$days_duration,project_csv$project_cost)
```

## dataForEDA
```{r}
EDA <-read.csv ("C:/Users/tyler/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Classes Spring 2026/BDA Spring 26/dataForEDA.csv", header=TRUE)
#head of data
head(EDA)
#summary of data
summary(EDA)
#mean of data 
mean(EDA$W)
# stand dev data
sd(EDA$W)
sd(EDA$Y)
sd(EDA$X)
sd(EDA$Z)
#mean of data
mean(EDA$X)
mean(EDA$Y)
mean(EDA$Z)
#correlation of data
cor(EDA)
#histogram 
hist(EDA$W)
hist(EDA$X)
hist(EDA$Y)
hist(EDA$Z)
# line plot of data
plot(EDA$W,type="b")
abline(h=mean(EDA$W))
plot(EDA$X,type="b")
plot(EDA$Y,type="b")
plot(EDA$Z,type="b")
# scatter plot of data
plot(EDA$W,EDA$X)
plot(EDA$W,EDA$Y)
plot(EDA$W,EDA$Z)
plot(EDA$X,EDA$Y)
plot(EDA$X,EDA$Z)
plot(EDA$Y,EDA$Z)
```
